tasks.label: Setup: Sync dependencies
tasks.detail: Create .venv with Python 3.14 and install locked development/validation dependencies. Preserve installed optional extras.

tasks.label: Setup: Sync dependencies with optional integrations
tasks.detail: Also install optional App Configuration and telemetry dependencies; does not configure or contact Azure services.

tasks.label: Setup: Check Python environment
tasks.detail: Run the Rich import/interpreter preflight without loading Azure settings.

tasks.label: Agents: Smoke test all local agents
tasks.detail: Requires all three local hosts already running. Sends real model requests sequentially and records Rich/JSONL results; can incur token charges. No deployment, grants, or automatic retries.

tasks.label: Agents: Preview hosted deployment (unsupported)
tasks.detail: Currently unsupported/skipped for hosted agents by azd. A successful exit is not a deployment plan or verification. No image build or deployment.

tasks.label: Agents: Deploy all hosted agents
tasks.detail: Explicit paid operation: remote ACR builds and immutable hosted agent versions. Existing foundation/model are reused.

tasks.label: Access: Preview hosted agent permissions
tasks.detail: Shows actual hosted instance principals and scoped Foundry User grants. Does not modify roles.

tasks.label: Access: Apply hosted agent permissions
tasks.detail: Explicit model/state data permission on the selected Foundry account for deployed agent identities, not the developer. No Blob or impersonation grants.

tasks.label: Agents: Smoke test all hosted agents
tasks.detail: Three real remote inference requests, one per active hosted agent, using the Azure CLI user. Can incur model/session usage. Not localhost.

tasks.label: Agents: Deploy and smoke test all hosted agents
dependsOn: Agents: Smoke test all hosted agents
tasks.detail: Explicit paid agent deployment, scoped agent RBAC, then independent hosted smoke. Does not verify delegation, isolation or recovery, or reprovision the foundation.

tasks.label: Access: Preview Supervisor impersonation permission
tasks.detail: Read-only plan for the Supervisor's single custom impersonation action at the selected project.

tasks.label: Access: Apply Supervisor impersonation permission
tasks.detail: Explicit custom impersonation role and project-scoped assignment only for the actual Supervisor identity. Does not establish working delegation. No Blob or telemetry grants.

tasks.label: Agents: Diagnose hosted caller context
tasks.detail: Direct Research versus one Supervisor-to-Research presence-only probe. No model inference, workflow-state writes, grants or deployments. Missing context is reported as FAIL.

tasks.label: Agents: Test hosted workflow state and delegation
tasks.detail: Currently blocked by missing verified specialist caller context. Paid synthetic hosted create/inspect/replay/continue, separate specialist histories and unknown-workflow rejection. No crash or OOM injection.

tasks.label: Agents: Deploy and test hosted delegation
dependsOn: Agents: Smoke test all hosted agents
Agents: Test hosted workflow state and delegation
tasks.detail: Currently blocked by missing verified specialist caller context. Explicit paid deployment, model permissions, independent smoke and workflow test; no foundation reprovisioning. Fails closed rather than bypassing isolation.

tasks.label: Infrastructure: Preview changes (Azure CLI)
tasks.detail: Read-only native what-if. Uses the checked-in North Central US preview inputs; does not provision or grant permissions.

tasks.label: Infrastructure: Preview changes (azd)
tasks.detail: Requires an initialized azd environment; the preprovision hook validates the subscription, environment name, and region.

tasks.label: Infrastructure: Apply changes (azd)
tasks.detail: MUTATES AZURE and can incur charges. Run only after reviewing the native what-if. Does not invoke developer RBAC grants.

tasks.label: Infrastructure: Inspect deployment operations
tasks.detail: Inspect operations after deployment. Inspect nested operations with az deployment operation group list.

tasks.label: Setup: Create .env from deployment
tasks.detail: Discovers the latest successful deployment for the selected environment. Creates .env without overwriting an existing file.

tasks.label: Setup: Update .env from deployment
tasks.detail: Refreshes only project endpoint, model deployment, and optional App Configuration endpoint. Preserves all other local values.

tasks.label: Access: Preview developer permissions
tasks.detail: Separate from deployment; reads outputs from the deployed foundation and previews missing scoped roles.

tasks.label: Access: Apply developer permissions
tasks.detail: Explicitly grants displayed missing roles, then verifies synthetic Blob/monitoring access. Never runs as a provisioning/debug hook.

inputs.description: Explicit Azure subscription name or ID
Exact timestamped subscription deployment name for operation inspection (az deployment sub list)
Environment whose latest successful deployment will be discovered
Local identity to grant (azd must match the az CLI user)
